description: Events in a time range, merged across all calendars and sorted by start. Recurring events are expanded into occurrences. Defaults to today through the next 7 days.

accounts.description: Account ids to limit to (default: all).

calendars.description: Calendar ids or names to limit to (default: all).

end.description: YYYY-MM-DD for all-day, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (local to the configured timezone unless it has Z/±HH:MM). A date-only end includes that whole day.

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD for all-day, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (local to the configured timezone unless it has Z/±HH:MM)

name: list_events
